AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem.

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundry: Stain Removal? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundry: Stain Removal.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundry: Stain Removal.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundry: Stain Removal.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Laundry: Stain Removal.

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Controlling Soil Erosion? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Controlling Soil Erosion.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Controlling Soil Erosion.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Controlling Soil Erosion.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Controlling Soil Erosion.

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

8. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A mixture of two liquids

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Good Grooming cleaning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Good Grooming cleaning.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Good Grooming cleaning.

   D. Guess results without recording observations on Good Grooming cleaning.

   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.

   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Water: seedbed pits? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Water: seedbed pits.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Water: seedbed pits.

12. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Crop Products? (1 mark)

   B. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Crop Products.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.

16. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring
